items.title: Phil Flanigan interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 15, 1998
items.q: I had lessons with Oscar Zimmerman, the principal bassist for the Rochester Philharmonic and also the teacher of Ron Carter among others.

ctx.x: In that program I just had theory class and lessons, two hours every Saturday, so that was for two years. So I probably went there a hundred times — well no, school year is probably less than that, probably eighty times or something for lessons. I had lessons with Oscar Zimmerman, the principal bassist for the Rochester Philharmonic and also the teacher of Ron Carter among others. I think me and Ron are the only ones really—
